recognize_zh: 淋巴結中可見上半部富含嗜中性球、核碎片與壞死的化膿性中心，下半部被淡粉紅色、梭形拉長的類上皮組織球呈柵欄狀排列包圍，這種「中央化膿壞死＋外圍類上皮組織球」的化膿性肉芽腫是兔熱病（tularemia）淋巴結炎的重要線索。
features: Central suppurative zone rich in neutrophils, karyorrhectic nuclear debris, and necrosis (upper field)
Peripheral rim of elongated epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval to spindled nuclei, arranged in a vaguely palisading pattern (lower field)
Transition zone with mixed neutrophils, histiocytes, and scattered lymphocytes
Many cells with clear halos consistent with degenerating neutrophils and apoptotic bodies
No well-formed multinucleated giant cells or organisms identifiable at this magnification
describe_en: Lymph node section shows necrotizing suppurative granulomatous inflammation. The upper portion consists of a central abscess-like zone containing abundant neutrophils, karyorrhectic debris, and necrosis, bordered below by a rim of elongated, palisading epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. Multinucleated giant cells and microorganisms are not identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with suppurative granulomatous lymphadenitis, a pattern seen in tularemia, cat-scratch disease, and lymphogranuloma venereum; Francisella tularensis serology or PCR and special stains for organisms are recommended.

ddx.vs: Cat-scratch disease produces an identical stellate suppurative granuloma, so the distinction relies on exposure history, Warthin-Starry or Bartonella immunostain, and serology.
Tuberculous granulomas show caseous rather than neutrophil-rich necrosis with Langhans giant cells and acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Kikuchi necrosis is rich in karyorrhexis and crescentic histiocytes but characteristically lacks neutrophils.
LGV shows similar stellate abscesses but involves inguinal nodes with Chlamydia trachomatis L1-L3 detected by PCR.
